name: tap-bucket-location
body: The Homebrew tap and Scoop bucket are hosted in the source repo `really-knows-ai/ey-present` itself: `Formula/` holds the Homebrew formula (and its custom download strategy) and `bucket/` holds the Scoop manifest, so `brew tap really-knows-ai/ey-present <git url>` and `scoop bucket add ey-present <git url>` work with users' existing git access to the private repo. No separate tap/bucket repos. AC: both commands succeed against the repo's git URL for a user with repo access.
